content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Jacksonville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—which balance your academic background against months of documented project leadership. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your current role and background meet the standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Over several weeks, you'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-style questions. Our Jacksonville cohorts run flexible schedules so working professionals can fit training around full-time responsibilities.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once your contact hours are complete, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and work experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application portal and answer questions about documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence before test day. Schedule your PMP exam through Pearson VUE. Our graduates access post-course support to clarify difficult domains and refine test-taking strategy.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning PMP, you'll need to earn professional development units (PDUs) every three years to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and workshops that count toward renewal. Plan now to build your PDU habit and stay current with industry best practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
